fixes.explanation: A hidden inner room! Ooh, I love a secret hideout, friend. But Jesus says the owner “…will show you a large upper room, furnished and ready.” Large and upstairs is what He tells them, and nothing in His words says it's tucked away. I think a hidden room would've sent those two disciples hunting like I hunt for my own mixing bowl.

Bethany is a real place, baker, so I get why it popped up. But Jesus has a different spot in mind. He says, “…I will go ahead of you into Galilee.” I think those disciples would've been standing in Bethany waiting, and Jesus would've been up in Galilee saying, “Where is everybody?” The place is Galilee, and He's the one going ahead.
